$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Unique item id, e.g. "oil-flask". Stable once shipped (saves).

notes.description: What the item is for, for designers and review.

nameKey.description: Localisation key of the display name; absent = "item.<id>.name".

descKey.description: Localisation key of the description; absent = "item.<id>.desc".

name.description: English display name until the string tables land (the inventory screen, mw-e17.10); absent = a readable form of the id.

description.description: English flavour text the inventory card shows (room for a joke), until the string tables land.

icon.description: Inventory icon asset id (style bible §15.1); a placeholder until the art lands.

value.description: Base price in gold (merchants adjust it, mw-e20).

stackable.description: Several units share one inventory entry.

maxStack.description: Units shown per stack (display chunking only, ADR-0003); required when stackable, forbidden otherwise.

weightClass.description: Impact noise and physics when dropped or thrown; never carried weight (ADR-0003).

slot.description: Slot it is worn or held in: main-hand, off-hand, both-hands.

proficiencies.description: Class proficiency tags it calls for, e.g. "blades", "heavy-armor" (class data, mw-e19.4). Soft: any class may equip it (mw-e17.4).

nonProficient.description: The penalty while worn by a class lacking any of its proficiencies (soft proficiency, mw-e17.4): the equip succeeds and the wearer pays this instead.

drawTimeMultiplier.description: Multiplier on the time to draw, ready or raise it (combat reads it, mw-e04/mw-e05). 1 = no penalty; default 1.5.

staminaCostMultiplier.description: Multiplier on the stamina its moves cost (combat reads it, mw-e04). 1 = no penalty; default 1.25.

noiseMultiplier.description: Multiplier on the wearer’s noise, on top of the load class (clamped with it, ADR-0003). 1 = no penalty; default 1.

moves.description: Moves it adds to the wielder’s moveset; its heft lives there (mw-e04).

oneOf.description: A weapon. Weightless for load (ADR-0003): its heft is in its moves.

worldProperties.description: World properties when dropped or thrown (an oil flask is flammable).

material.description: Material preset id (a material content entry).

freezePoint.description: Temperature at or below which it freezes, °C.

fragile.description: Impact energy that breaks it, J.

density.description: Density, kg/m³; below 1000 it floats in water.

climbable.description: Climbing grade: none, ladder, rope, ivy (easy), rough (needs a climber), sheer (needs a tool).

liftable.description: Can be picked up and carried.

hideable.description: An actor can hide in or behind it.

transparent.description: Light and sight pass through it.

impactAbsorb.description: Fraction of impact energy it absorbs, 0 … 1.

liquid.description: A liquid: it pours, puddles and can have a water surface.

flammableGas.description: A gas that ignites (flares or explodes) when fire reaches it.

extinguishable.description: A fire or light source that water, force or an interaction puts out.

waterSurface.description: Top surface of a body of liquid: cold freezes it into walkable ice (needs a liquid material).

unstable.description: Force of one push, blast or quake that topples it, J.

suspended.description: Hangs from its support; falls when the support breaks, burns or is cut.

support.description: Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none); set when the level spawns.

breakable.description: A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it.

blunt.description: Blunt hit energy that breaks it, J.

slash.description: Slash hit energy that breaks it, J.

pierce.description: Pierce hit energy that breaks it, J.

force.description: Force (blast, quake, boulder) energy that breaks it, J.

toughness.description: Per kind of hit, the single-hit energy that breaks a breakable object; a kind left out never does.

bashable.description: A shield bash or kick shoves it (or breaks it when breakable).

cuttable.description: Slash or pierce damage severs it.

shootable.description: Projectile impulse that fires its signal, N·s.

softAnchor.description: Rope arrows and hooks embed in it.

surfaceHardness.description: Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard).

chargeActivated.description: Stored charge at which the mechanism fires.

lightActivated.description: Light level on it at which the mechanism fires.

hidden.description: Not perceivable or targetable until revealed.

trapped.description: Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first (needs a trap).

trap.description: Trap definition id a trapped object triggers.

container.description: Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component).

remains.description: Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise.

noiseMultiplier.description: Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's.

grants.description: Capabilities the item grants while equipped or carried (ADR-0004).

capability.description: Capability id declared in src/content/data/capability/, e.g. "spell.mage-hand".

while.description: When the player has it: while the item is equipped (an equipment:<id> source), or while it is carried, e.g. a tool on the belt (ADR-0004).

crossClass.description: Any class gains it through this item, e.g. a crowbar’s pry (ADR-0004 "simple" rule); default false.

use.description: Effects of using it; absent = no use.

oneOf.description: Restore points of a pool (a potion, a ration).
A found boon item: raise a pool’s maximum one step, once (ADR-0004).

status.description: Status id, e.g. "warded" (the condition DSL reads it, mw-e22).
